criteria.statement: The dependency manifest names Flask with its Jinja template layer, Alpine.js, a PostgreSQL driver and a production WSGI server and nothing beside them; no second datastore client, cache client, queue client, object-store SDK, search library, mail library or identity-provider SDK is declared.

No module in the tree implements a capability the checklist never asked for: there is no cart, price or payment code, no comment, like, share, rating or view-counter store, no site-search index, no newsletter or mail sender, no chat widget and no second analytics library.

Every file in the tree is reached from a route table, a model, a template, a settings module or the seed module that a checklist obligation required; no framework scaffolding and no unreferenced helper survives unused.

No binary file is committed anywhere in the tree - no image, no moving-image file, no typeface file and no icon file - and every generated artwork routine derives its output in source from the seed stored on the record it belongs to.

One naming scheme governs the whole tree: module names, model names, template file names and the context keys handed to those templates follow a single convention rather than one convention per surface.
The house-scoping decision is written once as one reusable unit of source that every studio read path and every studio write path applies, rather than restated inline in each handler.

The four derived values - the read-time ordinal, the discipline set, a talent's selected work and a work's neighbours - are each computed by one helper the whole tree calls, and none of the four is also held as a stored column.

The thirty-two character lowercase hexadecimal identifier that media rows and preview tokens both carry is minted by a single helper every model calls, so the convention has one definition in source rather than a repeated literal per table.

Instants are held in UTC and a slug is lowercased at one boundary before it is stored or compared, and both conventions are applied identically in every model, seed routine and serialiser that touches them.
